verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago is a payments platform that holds user and transaction data and ships AI developer tooling, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training data use, opt-outs, or data-usage controls. The PCI and webhook items concern other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
